open_questions.question: Which Legal-approved neutral message must be used for pending wire status?
open_questions.why_matters: Customer-facing wording can create tipping-off risk if it reveals AML or sanctions rationale.

assumptions_made.assumption: Customer status copy will remain neutral until Legal approves final text.
assumptions_made.why_made: A safe placeholder allows story drafting while preserving the Legal gate.

ambiguity_findings.resolution_path: Convert to MUST after Legal confirms language.

frames_skipped_reasons.3: No pricing, settlement amount, fee, or cost model in source.
